Results

Litter size ranged from `r min(dat$littersize)` to `r max(dat$littersize)` pups. Litter growth rate ranged from `r round(min(dat$growthrate), 2)` to `r round(max(dat$growthrate), 2)` g/day.

Mean partrition date was `r round(mean(dat$bjulian))` Julian day.

The average mother age was `r round(mean(dat$mother_age))` years.

with the average local density on Agnes grid increasing at a rate of 0.13 squirrels/ha every year over the 12 years of its food experiment. Over the entire study, squirrels on food supplemented grids experienced higher local densities, with an average of 2.44 squirrels/ha, compared to those on control grids, that had on average 2.05 squirrels/ha.
